flwor-example.description: Find all books published after 1940 with titles starting with 'The'
flwor-example.query: for $b in //book where $b/year > 1940 and starts-with($b/title, "The") return <result>{$b/title}</result>

fulltext-example.description: Search for books containing 'society' in their content
fulltext-example.query: for $b in //book where $b/content contains text "society" return $b/title
